cues.title: The Age of Dinosaurs
cues.text: Sixty-six million years ago, dinosaurs ruled the Earth as undisputed apex predators, an unbroken reign spanning over one hundred and sixty million years.

cues.title: The Chicxulub Impactor
cues.text: From deep space, a mountain-sized asteroid ten kilometers wide hurtled toward Earth at forty-five thousand miles per hour.

cues.title: Cataclysmic Impact & Megatsunami
cues.text: The impact in the Yucatan unleashed the fury of one hundred million megatons, triggering apocalyptic megatsunamis hundreds of meters high.

cues.title: The Deccan Traps Supervolcanoes
cues.text: Shockwaves fractured the Earth's mantle, triggering the Deccan Traps supervolcanoes and pumping billions of tons of toxic sulfur into the skies.

cues.title: Nuclear Winter & Ecosystem Collapse
cues.text: A suffocating blanket of soot blotted out the sun for a decade. Global temperatures plummeted, photosynthesis halted, and the food chain collapsed.

cues.title: The Iridium Boundary & Rise of Mammals
cues.text: Seventy-five percent of all species vanished forever, leaving a thin layer of cosmic iridium... and sparking the dawn of the age of mammals.
